# Home Environment Manager v0.6.0b31 — Restore room targets and PID controls after startup

This beta fixes Home Assistant entities that appeared unavailable or disappeared after beta30 even following an integration update and Home Assistant restart.

## Fix: per-device numeric controls survive offline physical sources

- The managed controller's PID gains (Kp, Ki, Kd), PID sampling and cycle intervals, and minimum/maximum ON/OFF times are **stored configuration**, not physical measurements. They no longer disappear when the native thermostat/fan/humidifier has not advertised capabilities at platform startup.
- Even with no native HA state, a configured native controller exposes its applicable minimum ON/OFF and maximum ON controls, and preserves PID controls for an existing PID selection or previously registered PID numbers.
- Existing unique IDs are reused; no registry deletion, hardware command, forced migration, device reset or hidden authorization is involved.

## Fix: Room Environment Comfort/Home/Away/Sleep/Eco temperature and humidity

- Room targets previously shown for compatible equipment stay registered when that equipment is temporarily unavailable at Home Assistant boot.
- When selected equipment advertises its real heat/cool/humidity capabilities **after** Number platform startup, newly applicable room target entities and supported PID tuning numbers are added without requiring another Home Assistant restart.
- Support remains capability-driven: a heat-only source never gets an invented cooling or humidity actuator, and a selected controller that has genuinely been removed is not revived.

## Safety and scope

Exactly one canonical integration domain: `environment_manager`. No migration code or alternate domain. Room/physical device identities and existing user-selected values are unchanged. PID/Automatic/Manual selection and physical ON/OFF remain subject to the existing runtime safety, sensor validity, minimum runtime, window/ownership and command-acknowledgement checks; this patch changes only entity exposure/refresh, never physical actuation policy.

The beta includes startup/offline recovery regression tests, on-state-change duplicate protection, installed Home Assistant 2026.10 native NumberEntity checks, both supported Python versions, frontend checks, translations, HACS, Hassfest and flat HACS tag extraction.

Stable Latest remains v0.5.1. This beta is opt-in; physical HVAC testing is separate from CI.
